links.outcome: Accuracy of urgent versus non-urgent classification of simulated dry eye complaints, prompted vs non-prompted
links.effect: Accuracy rose from 80.1% without the specialized prompt to 99.6% with it, with longer response time. Missed and unnecessary escalations were not reported separately.
links.quote: A comparison between prompted and non-prompted queries reveals a significant accuracy increase from 80.1–99.6%.
